title: Shih Tzu Dog Tags for Sassy Lion Dogs | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny shih tzu dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Sassy sayings on the front, your dog's name and phone number on the back. From $12 a tag.
blurb: Engraved tags for the breed bred to sit on royalty that now sits on your best throw pillow like it signed the lease. Ten pounds of lion who can't see past their own bangs.

tough.h2: Humidity, bath day, and a tag that survives both
tough.html:
A shih tzu spends half its life in humid air and the other half getting blow-dried. Printed tags fade, peel and give up somewhere around the third bath.

Ours don't, because there's no ink to lose. The words are laser engraved into the metal, so shampoo and the water bowl they get their whole beard into can't touch the lettering.

Bath day, beach day, August. All fine.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Underbites and dramatic breathing are a bulldog specialty too. These lines are for the small, fluffy branch of the family.

sayings.h2: 8 shih tzu sayings for a dog with palace ancestry
sayings.lead: The bows, the underbite, the reverse sneezes that sound like a tiny emergency, and the refusal to walk one more step. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will baths, grooming and humidity ruin an engraved tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off, fade or peel.

items.q: Can I put my shih tzu's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Will the tag get tangled in my shih tzu's hair?
items.a: Long coats wrap around anything that dangles. Ask your groomer for a little clearance at the neck and the tag will hang where people can read it.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
